opportunities.name: PR Review Webhook Agent
opportunities.description: Agent listens for GitHub pull request webhooks, processes diffs with DeepSeek API, and posts review comments via GitHub API.
opportunities.architecture: User registers webhook URL at your endpoint. GitHub sends PR event → agent fetches diff via GitHub API → sends to DeepSeek for review → posts comments back via GitHub API.
opportunities.notes: Assume 1 repo per customer average. DeepSeek cost ~$0.01 per review, profit $8.99 per review.

opportunities.name: Lead Enrichment Webhook Agent
opportunities.description: Agent receives form submission webhooks (e.g., from Typeform, HubSpot), extracts company domain, uses DeepSeek to research company (via web search or API), and sends enriched data (industry, size, contacts) back via webhook response or email.
opportunities.architecture: User registers webhook URL. Form submission event → agent extracts email/domain → queries DeepSeek with company name → returns enriched JSON to user's callback URL.
opportunities.notes: DeepSeek cost ~$0.02 per enrichment, profit $0.08 per lead.

opportunities.name: Support Ticket Classifier Webhook Agent
opportunities.description: Agent receives email webhooks (via SendGrid or similar) containing support tickets, uses DeepSeek to categorize (billing, technical, feature request), and routes to appropriate Slack channel or email address.
opportunities.architecture: User registers webhook URL. Email sent to your endpoint → agent parses email body → sends to DeepSeek for classification → sends result to user's Slack webhook or email.
opportunities.notes: DeepSeek cost ~$0.01 per classification, profit $0.04 per ticket.

opportunities.name: Invoice Processor Webhook Agent
opportunities.description: Agent receives invoice PDFs via webhook (e.g., from email or upload), uses DeepSeek to extract fields (invoice number, date, amount, line items), and sends data to accounting API (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero).
opportunities.architecture: User registers webhook URL. Invoice PDF sent as attachment → agent downloads PDF, converts to text (e.g., via PyPDF2), sends to DeepSeek for extraction → posts to accounting API.
opportunities.notes: DeepSeek cost ~$0.05 per invoice, profit $0.20 per invoice.

notes: All services use webhook registration, DeepSeek processing, and response via webhook/email. CLI management via simple Node.js or Python script. Capital includes API costs and basic server (e.g., $20/mo VPS). Implementation complexity: Low = <1 week, Medium = 1-2 weeks, High = 2-4 weeks.
